title: Korean Jjigae Stuffed Hazelnut Chicken Breast
description: A keto-friendly twist on traditional Korean jjigae, featuring chicken breast stuffed with a hazelnut-based filling and served with a side of aerated kimchi.
instructions: In a food processor, combine hazelnuts, Korean chili flakes, and gochujang. Process until well combined.
Stuff each chicken breast with the hazelnut mixture.
Season the chicken with salt and black pepper.
Heat sesame oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breasts until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve with a side of aerated kimchi.
